verdict.rationale: Algolia is a hosted SaaS search platform, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion workflows, or data-lifecycle controls. Generic mentions that the Search API can 'manage your indices and records', and that Agent Studio caches completions by default, do not show user-controllable retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
